summary: City page confirms 4 x 30-amp sites, hydrant water (no water/sewer hookups), clubhouse restrooms, no showers, free-will offering, first come first served; all now manual. Phone and website flags.

PIN (unconfirmed, no move): stored 48.02580,-98.12680 lands in a residential lot east of the street; the Duffers clubhouse (brown-roofed building by the golf course cart path) is ~100 m SW at ~48.0251,-98.1279, and Google's park pin is 48.02613,-98.12753.
